analysis.inconclusive_action: retain all runs; consider more training repeats without editing original outcomes
analysis.primary: clean planar velocity RMSE [m/s], equal weight per command/episode then per training seed
analysis.threshold_status: implementation defaults chosen before new results; exploratory screening, not acceptance criteria for publication
analysis.uncertainty: paired training-seed t intervals and Holm adjustment; low precision with n=3
analysis.unit: independently trained policy; episodes are repeated measurements

command_curriculum: disabled for every arm; fixed common command support

evaluation.failure_tail: zero physical velocity through the fixed horizon; also report completion and alive-only errors
evaluation.holdout_gate: all twelve formal policies sealed before any holdout rollout
evaluation.policy: deterministic mean, frozen normalizer, CPU float32 ONNX

latency.scope: normalization, gathers, encoders, fusion, head; excludes simulation and sensor IO

normalization: shared policy: running per-feature statistics fitted on each policy training rollouts only

pilot_amendment.actor_observation: 98 base terms plus native 187-D terrain_scan height map = 285
pilot_amendment.budget: 512 environments x 300 updates; one training seed
pilot_amendment.scope: exploratory short pilot; not the frozen 98-D study

question: Does separate terrain-scan encoding improve G1 rough-terrain velocity control?

stopping.budget_exhaustion: report INCOMPLETE; never replace missing results with pilot results
stopping.evaluation: fixed horizon; first non-timeout termination marks episode failed
stopping.training: fixed updates; abort numerical or identity failures; no performance early stopping
